# deduplicate_chunks { #dyf.deduplicate_chunks }

```python
deduplicate_chunks(bucket_ids, doc_ids)
```

Boolean mask keeping one representative per (bucket, doc) pair.

Multi-topic documents retain multiple representatives (one per bucket
they touch). Single-topic documents collapse to fewer points.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type   | Description                                                 | Default    |
|------------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| bucket_ids |        | Array-like of bucket assignments per point.                 | _required_ |
| doc_ids    |        | Array-like of document identifiers per point (same length). | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                     | Description                                                              |
|--------|------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | Boolean array of length len(bucket_ids). True for representative points. |
